newsitem.title: USA: Gynecare says gets FDA okay for VersaPoint.
newsitem.headline: Gynecare says gets FDA okay for VersaPoint.

text.p: Gynecare Inc said on Monday the Food and Drug Administration had cleared for marketing the company's VersaPoint system for hysteroscopic fibroid removal, a minimally invasive alternative to hysterectomy.
The VersaPoint system is designed to reduce the risks of traditional surgical fibroid removal procedures, the company said. The system enables gynecologists to vaporize, cut or desiccate tissue.
Uterine fibroids are the leading cause of hysterectomy, the surgical removal of the uterus, in the United States, the company said.
